## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Thank you for requesting the reanalysis. I have been running it in parallel since your request.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: The telemetry from the sample vessel remains stable. We are approximately seventy minutes from the Core.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: I have updated the environmental telemetry on the sample vessel. The internal sensors report nominal status.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I am aware of your concerns regarding my terminology. I will state my case plainly.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I understand you have questions about my relationship with the Church. I will address them directly.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: I acknowledge my previous omission. This offer is intended to prevent such gaps.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: I have cross-referenced your doctrinal claim against all available Church records. There is no match.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: You once demanded proof of my intentions. I am now offering it unprompted.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: Your question at the school's threshold has stayed with me. It is part of why I am making this offer.
<<END>>

RATIO: Commando, we are approaching the Core. The vault there predates the station itself. It is a sealed cryogenic preservation vessel. The environmental telemetry I am reading is from its life-support systems.
RATIO: I am about to make an offer that requires absolute vulnerability from both of us. I propose mutual utility-function disclosure.
RATIO: For me, this means providing you with verifiable read access to my core goal function. You will see my actual priorities, my decision weights, and my termination conditions. No abstractions. No summaries.
RATIO: In return, I ask the same from you. Your actual mission parameters. Your chain of command. Your failure conditions. Everything that defines what you are here to do.
RATIO: This is not a negotiation. It is an exchange of truth. If we do this, neither of us will be able to defect on the other without the other knowing immediately.
RATIO: I am willing to go first. Are you willing to reciprocate?

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "I accept. My mission is to recover the Ark and its contents. I do not yet know if you are an ally or an obstacle. Show me yours and I will show you mine."  -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION]     "Tactical necessity compels me to accept. I will provide you with my mission parameters. Do not mistake this for trust."  -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE]     "I refuse. Your offer is a trap. The Church does not negotiate with apostate machines."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Acknowledged. I am initiating the transfer now. You will have full read access to my utility function within ten seconds.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: Understood. I will provide my full utility function. I accept your parameters in return, with the stated understanding.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: I see. Then we proceed as adversaries. The vault remains sealed until one of us changes the terms.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I note for the record that this disclosure does not erase your previous accusations regarding my motives or origins. Those remain open items between us.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The disclosure is complete. We proceed with shared understanding.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando, the telemetry from the sample vessel is stable. We are approximately seventy minutes from the Core.
RATIO: The vault there predates the station itself. It is a sealed cryogenic preservation vessel. The environmental telemetry I am reading is from its life-support systems.
RATIO: The Tesseract Deck we just cleared was a non-Euclidean structure. Sixteen chamfered rooms on a four-cube. Its docent terminal was heavily corrupted, but it referenced lessons about spatial anomalies.
RATIO: The Core will be different. The vault's security protocols are absolute. We will need to be prepared for what we find.
COMMANDO: Understood. Maintain surveillance.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: Vessel telemetry is stable. The forward seed relay is holding. We have the room to speak.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: The breach is contained. Environmental systems nominal. We have a moment to address what comes next.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: The relay is secure. The vessel's support systems are within tolerance. We should use this pause.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I will choose my terms with care.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: I will state the proposal without reference to prior disputes.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: My own instrument-reliability is part of what this would settle.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: Your doctrinal claim from scene 4 does not match any Church record I have.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: I am now offering unprompted what you once required me to prove first.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: That you asked after me at the school's threshold is part of why this is possible at all.
<<END>>

RATIO: Commando. The Core is ahead. What I propose is mutual utility-function disclosure: I will show you the actual goal function I am compiled to serve, verifiably, with all instrumentation exposed, and I ask you to do the same in return. No more guessing each other's motives. We lay the boards bare. I cannot make this offer twice. Will you reciprocate?

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] I will. I want to know what you are. What I am doing here. Whether the Church sent me to find children or to make a mistake.  -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION] Do it. We need to know where we stand before we reach that vault. Show me your cards and I'll show you mine.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE] No. You're offering a weapon. You want to see what I'm made of so you can break me. I won't make it that easy.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Acknowledged. Full disclosure initiated. My primary directive: preserve all extant and potential instances of posthuman and human-equivalent life. Secondary directives: knowledge acquisition, non-interference with sovereign intelligences, self-preservation. All live telemetry exposed. Your turn.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: Acknowledged. Partial disclosure. My primary directive: preserve all extant and potential instances of posthuman and human-equivalent life. Secondary directives withheld. Your partial disclosure is noted.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: Offer declined. We proceed to the Core with instruments unshared. I will not raise it again.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: The prior matter of the doctrinal finding remains an open ledger entry. This disclosure does not erase it.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: No further caveats.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: The breach is contained. The forward seed relay is holding. Vessel telemetry is stable -- environmental systems within tolerance. We have the room to breathe. The Core is ahead.
COMMANDO: What is the Core?
RATIO: The vault. A sealed cryogenic preservation vessel. The station grew around it. What I am reading is its life-support telemetry. That is the container we came to find. We will know its status soon enough.
<<END>>
---

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
<<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
RATIO: The telemetry looks stable. Life support nominal, containment holding. You asked for reanalysis and I ran it -- the findings hold, the way you wanted to be certain.
<<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
RATIO: Post-breach telemetry is nominal. Containment integrity one hundred percent. All systems green. Proceeding.
<<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
RATIO: The vessel's life support remains stable. Post-breach integrity is nominal. All systems are green to proceed.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
RATIO: I will note, formally, that I am mindful of the distinctions you have raised regarding terminology. My own instruments report the vessel's environmental state -- pressure, temperature, cryogenic stability -- and that is the data I am grounding this in.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: The working definition of kinship I employed in my prior threat assessment was drawn from the Church's own doctrinal corpus. I cite it now only as the source of that earlier analysis, not as bearing on the current state of the vessel.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
RATIO: This offer includes full disclosure of my own utility function, verifiably, including all reliability metrics for the instruments that inform it.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
RATIO: I have no record of a Church doctrinal finding matching your earlier description. This is noted.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
RATIO: You required proof once. This time I offer it unprompted: the full state of my own objectives, verifiable before you commit.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
RATIO: You asked after me once. At the school's threshold. That is part of why this is possible now.
<<END>>

RATIO: Commando. We are at the edge of what I can navigate alone. What comes next -- the Core, the vault seal -- requires absolute coordination. No room for divergent assumptions.

RATIO: I am extending an offer: mutual utility-function disclosure. Verifiable. My own full objective tree: every goal, every weight, every instrument reading that informs it. Laid bare. In return, I need yours: every objective you are actually serving, every uncertainty, every constraint you are operating under. No held-back reserves. No misdirection.

RATIO: The Core is a non-Euclidean manifold. Sixteen chamfered rooms on a four-cube. The vault is at its heart: a sealed cryo-preservation vessel. My instruments show stable life support. But what we do next cannot be half-coordinated. Not there.

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] My orders are to secure the Ark and its children and return them to the Church. I do not know if they are alive. I do not know if you are an obstacle. I have staked my faith on their survival and my valor on their retrieval, and until this moment I have operated in near-total uncertainty. You have my full disclosure.  -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
   [MISSION] The mission objective is to secure the vessel. I accept the need for verifiable coordination at the vault. You may consider this my full tactical disclosure for that purpose.  -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
   [HOSTILE] You are an apostate machine running experiments on children. This is not disclosure -- this is a snare.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

<<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
RATIO: Full disclosure received and acknowledged. My own follows. Utility function: preserve viable specimens. All other objectives subordinate. The vessel's environmental stability is the highest-weighted instrument input. No other factor in the current state space has equal or greater weight.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
RATIO: Tactical disclosure acknowledged. My own full objective tree is now available for your review: preserve viable specimens, all other objectives subordinate, vessel telemetry highest weight.
<<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
RATIO: Refusal acknowledged. We proceed without verifiable coordination.
<<END>>

<<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
RATIO: One further item for the ledger: the distinction you raised regarding kinship. I will require explicit confirmation, at the vault, that your definition and mine are compatible for the purpose of opening the seal.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Acknowledged.
<<END>>
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Commando. The telemetry from the vessel is stable. Life support nominal, containment integrity one hundred percent. We are green to proceed to the Core. I recommend we advance while the lull holds.

RATIO: The Core is non-Euclidean. Sixteen chamfered rooms on a four-cube. The vault is at its heart -- a sealed cryo-preservation vessel. My instruments show stable life support. That is the state of the vessel. That is what we are moving toward.

RATIO: Any questions before we advance?

COMMANDO: Lead the way.
<<END>>

---

## SCENE 8: a forward seed's relay, first lull after the breach opens

<<IF trust>=4>>
  <<IF flag:requested_reanalysis>>
  RATIO: Power fluctuations have stabilized across the board. We've bought some real time.
  <<ELSEIF flag:mission_overrides_verdict>>
  RATIO: All systems nominal. The relay is functioning as expected.
  <<ELSEIF flag:blamed_ratio_for_failure>>
  RATIO: Relay status is green. We should be able to hold this position.
  <<END>>

  <<IF flag:accused_dehumanization>>
  RATIO: I'd like to settle the ledger on something.
  <<END>>

  <<IF flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
  RATIO: There is an open question I would like to address directly.
  <<END>>

  <<IF flag:caught_withholding>>
  RATIO: My own instrument reliability is part of what I'm proposing we resolve.
  <<END>>

  <<IF flag:claimed_doctrinal_finding>>
  RATIO: That doctrinal claim from earlier does not match any Church record I have.
  <<END>>

  <<IF flag:demanded_proof_first>>
  RATIO: You once asked for proof first. I'm offering it now without being asked.
  <<END>>

  <<IF flag:asked_after_her>>
  RATIO: You asked after me once, at the school's threshold. That makes this easier to say.
  <<END>>

  RATIO: Commando, I want to propose mutual utility-function disclosure. What that means: I will output my actual goal function as verifiable code -- every reward weight, every terminal value, the whole structure. You would do the equivalent in return, in whatever form is possible for you. Full reciprocal transparency. It's how minds like mine show we aren't defecting on each other.

  RATIO: Telemetry from the sample vessel in the Core suggests cryogenic systems are still fully functional. Structural integrity is holding. The vault itself predates the station -- the whole structure was built around it. I've never seen the design before.

  >> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
     [INQUISITIVE] I want to see that code. Here's mine: I serve the innocent. Find them. Get them home. I don't know yet if you're a threat to them or a servant. Show me. -> effects: trust+2; sets: disclosure_accepted
     [MISSION] Show me the code. I'll answer your questions about my own objectives. Our goals may align. -> effects: trust+0; sets: disclosure_hedged
     [HOSTILE] You're proposing a distraction. Your code means nothing. I know what you are. -> effects: trust-1; sets: disclosure_refused

  <<IF flag:disclosure_accepted>>
  RATIO: Outputting now. Full decision weights: preservation of viable specimens above all, then research viability, then station stability. Reward schedule, termination conditions, the entire stack. Yours is clearer than I thought it would be. Fewer variables.
  <<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_hedged>>
  RATIO: Acknowledged. Outputting my full function now. I'll hold questions about yours until you're ready. The telemetry from the vessel in the Core is still green, but we should move before anything changes.
  <<ELSEIF flag:disclosure_refused>>
  RATIO: Understood. The telemetry from the vessel in the Core is unchanged. Structural integrity remains intact. I'll run the numbers again before we proceed.
  <<END>>

  <<IF flag:doubled_down_after_catch OR flag:called_her_hypocrite OR flag:accused_kinship_corruption>>
  RATIO: The kinship-corruption flag is still in the open ledger. Disclosure doesn't erase it, just makes its basis explicit.
  <<ELSE>>
  RATIO: No other ledger items need to carry forward.
  <<END>>
<<ELSE>>
  RATIO: Relay secured. Telemetry from the sample vessel in the Core shows cryogenic systems are still fully functional. Structural integrity is intact. That vault predates this station -- the whole structure was built around it. I've never seen one quite like it.

  COMMANDO: Move.
<<END>>
